description: This is a Python source file defining various prompt templates, utility functions, and conversion utilities for a machine learning / LLM project. It includes functions for constructing prompts for different models, handling system and user messages, and converting message formats for multiple LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, and Vertex AI. It also contains logic for embedding thought signatures, processing images, and managing tool invocation/response formats across different frameworks.
